notes.title: New Patch Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/f73c7a433733ac9a1e54dc6a155247a36496a9c1.jpg

Dear CEOs!
Do your New Year Resolutions include sending a rocket with your name on it into space? Well then, now is a great time to get back to Space Company Simulator! The new patch concentrates on fixing bugs reported by the community. 

You can check the full list of the changes below.

In addition, the game is now 30% off. Get Space Company Simulator by January 22 to become the best CEO in the space transportation industry. 

And if you like the changes, please consider dropping us a review or updating your previous one. They help us understand if we’re going in the right direction. Thanks!

Changelog:

 Fixed a bug where the “Space Program Mars'' building wasn’t necessary to finish the game. What, did you really think it was that easy?
 Fixed a bug where players could enter the Mission Control Center while the administration window was open.
 Astronauts now have a unique picture. 
 Events from the lower calendar now disappear while a player skips turns. Like they should. Let’s keep the calendar in order.
 Fixed the placeholder amounts in Weekly Revenue and Weekly Installments in Loans.
 Decision emails now make you gain or lose money. Do you feel the pressure of being a CEO yet?
 Full UI elements added to the Test Center.
 Fixed the text under Company Motto in the main menu.
 Buying the perks for Small Rocket “Dog-9”, Small Rocket “Hound-7”, or Medium Rocket “Space Explorer” MR-1 now unlocks the blueprints correctly. Try it!
 Fixed a bug where the particle system wouldn’t turn off after a rocket’s launch.
 Added missing descriptions of construction conditions to the Building map.
 The game no longer freezes when players access the Assembly Room.
 UI symbols of the settings menu now appear after players change the language to Polish.
 Fixed the marking of the Small Launcher building.
 There are no longer visual graphical artifacts on the building mode icon.

You can discuss the new changes and share your feedback with us in Steam Discussions and on Discord. 

Now let’s get ready for the lift off!

CEOs! 
We know you’re busy people, so many logistics, construction, and launches to oversee—so we don’t want to take up too much of your time. 

We hope you’ve been enjoying the new update and the new UI it introduced. We just wanted to add some additional fixes and solve an issue that resulted in the game crashing. After downloading this patch, you should be cleared for launch!

 Fixed the menu and windows of buildings so they don’t overlap event icons on the timeline
 Fixed the progress bar so that it is within UI bounds
 Corrected the "Choose" button’s location in the departments' perk trees
 Fixed graphical artifacts so their upgrade shader isn’t too bright
 Fixed the "Building map" button so that it disappears after opening the Building map
 Fixed the Production Department section names disappearing when entering the Depot or Assembly Room and going back
 Fixed emails so that the decision box is not cut off 
 Fixed the menu so that users cannot drag contracts outside of it
 Fixed the title of the rocket program building so that it wasn’t shifted out of bounds of the title area
 Fixed action buttons in emails so they have a disabling state instead of a hovering one 
 Fixed lock icons so that they appear during a first entrance into any department

If you were too busy constructing and planning to check out the new update, read about the details here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/923970/announcements/detail/2949256017992357818

We’ve really appreciated getting your feedback as it helps us a lot—keep the data stream coming! And remember, networking is the way to the stars. Discuss the game with other CEO’s in Steam Discussions and on our Discord server.

notes.title: New Update available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/72123fab563464ba2baeeb5341d99f05e455cdad.jpg

Dear Space CEOs!
We’re back with a new update and a sale! Get Space Company Simulator before November 12 and reach the stars with a 30% discount to lighten your load!

The new update features major some upgrades to overall performance, many bug fixes including the Cash Overflow bug, and a completely redesigned UI! A full list of changes can be found below.

We know it’s been a while, so we would like to thank you for your patience while we were working on this update and hope that you’ll enjoy all the improvements.

Please give the new Update a try and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us more than you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/29ddc5421c52f627d5dc2534b6d953a32b13214b.jpg
Contracts are waiting for you in the inbox, Boss!

Main features:
 Major performance improvements
 Implemented transition of render from HDRP (High Definition Render Pipeline) to URP (Universal Render Pipeline) in the Unity Engine
 Fixed variable overflow (including cash overflow)
 Reconfigured particle systems and shaders for URP in Rocket Launch
 Converted the space environment of the Solar system to URP render
 Improved post processing settings in the space environment of the Solar system
 Redesigned and implemented the left navigation menu inside buildings
 Reworked and integrated the windows of contracts
 Reworked the timeline bar
 Implemented the logic of scheduled launch dates on the timeline
 Implemented technologies’ colors indicating current status
 Implemented requirements for the construction of buildings
 Implemented descriptions of buildings’ functionality
 Reconfigured elements of visual effects: clouds, terrain, lightning, and more
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block window in the building mode tree
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the building mode tree
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the perks tree for all departments
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block windows for the HR, PR, Finance, and Production trees
 Reworked and integrated the UI of game events
 Reworked and integrated icons for events
 Improved and integrated the work of Events
 Implemented new UX logic for new art elements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/62267eb9caf3a8b221bcdd06c4582ecc9d4b1d7a.jpg
T - 3… 2… 1… Liftoff!

Bug fixes:
 Fixed the issue with the build freezing when creating a new game after completing the construction of any building
 Fixed the issue with pictured buildings not being visible on the constructed building icons
 Fixed the issue with duplicating pop-up’s logic of "Human Resources 2" building
 Fixed the issue of an incorrect pop-up saying "Public relations 2" building after completing construction
 Fixed the issue with the titles "Medium depot" and "Big depot" disappearing after building the big depot
 Fixed the issue with incorrect pop-up of the "Medium depot" building after completing its construction  
 Fixed the issue with an incorrect image on the "Medium launcher" building pop-up
 Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building icon being displayed incorrectly after completing construction 
 Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building having an incorrect pop-up after completing construction
 Fixed the issue of the progress not being displayed in the pop-up of a building icon in building mode
 Fixed the issue of the missing "Mission Control" building pop-up menu 
 Fixed the issue with the change of day and night by skipping a turn
 Fixed the issue with the tree trunks not being displayed
 Fixed the issue with employee images being displayed too early when starting a new game
 Fixed the issue with green elements being reflected in the pop-up window of a building that hasn’t been built yet
 Fixed the issue of the space environment of the Solar system not having any texture
 Fixed the issue with the shader of foliage trees 
 Fixed more lighting issues
 And more!

Known issues:
 The menus and windows of buildings in the Events window overlap the icon of events on the timeline
 The percentage progression on the Research tree icons for the Science department is displayed incorrectly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/e132391cb5deab4dd96a345d9e946c13fdbb182e.jpg
The schedule is packed with events. It's going to be an interesting year!

Feedback
Once you give the new Update a try, let us know what you think! We’re especially curious to discover how much you like the new UI and how you feel about the game’s performance improvements. Share your impressions in Steam Discussions and on our Discord server.

If you like the game and the new changes, please also consider dropping us a review on Steam. They help us a lot!

Stay on course and aim for the stars!

Dear Space CEOs!
We're still working on changes to make Space Company Simulator top of the line. In this patch, we focused mainly on the aspects of rocket assembly, but we’ve also taken care of many other issues. Here’s the full list of changes:

Changelog

🔧 ASSEMBLY:
 Fixed the issue with the second Engine slot disappearing
 Fixed the issue with the Rocket Tank slot being active when placing Struts
 Component slots are no longer covered by the Inventory tab
 Fixed the issue with exceeding the allowed threshold of components which distorted other values in the Technical Overview tab 
 Fixed the incorrect display of component size information (S / M / L) which prevented components from being placed in corresponding slots 
 Sandbox Assembly: Thumbnail preview at rocket startup updates correctly
 Fixed the issue with disappearing component slot names
 Fixed the issue with inability to produce more components in a single turn after already commissioning the production of a certain component
 Fixed the issue with “Launch the rocket” and “Abort” buttons appearing in the Assembly after pressing certain keys
 Improved component grouping in the Inventory

⚙ SETTINGS:
 Fixed the issue with the game switching to Windowed mode after selecting any game mode
 Fixed the issue with incorrect save data in Save & Load panels
 Fixed the issue with the save button constantly remaining active in the graphic settings
 Fixed the issue with settings not refreshing despite the changes
 Fixed the issue whereby Windowed mode would activate when opening the Settings menu

📈 PERKS:
 Fixed the issue with the value of Perk points gain and money loss not updating after skipping turns or reloading the game
 Fixed the issue with the Second Child and Apple of My Eye Perks which prevented players from buying more Perks
 Fixed the issue with Perk Trees scrolling across various departments

🏢 BUILDINGS:
 Fixed the issue with the marketing building texture not refreshing after closing the PR panel
 Fixed the issue with exclamation marks not appearing when there’s a new building that can be constructed
 Lights in buildings no longer work during daytime
 Fixed the issue whereby players had to click RMB to be able to select buildings after loading the game from the in-game menu
 The Department management menu can no longer be opened while in the Building mode
 Fixed the Building Process information updates in the Buildings Map
 Fixed the issue with buildings not changing their status after clicking the ”Build” button on consecutive game launches 

📌 OTHER:
 Fixed the bug displaying the wrong background (Space Atlas) when entering the Assembly from Mission Control
 Fixed the issue with planets' details disappearing when zooming too close in the Mission Control window
 Fixed the issue with the Department Efficiency not refreshing correctly
 Corrected one of the Investor’s Best Player Bonus information
 Hid notifications from the Rocket Launch window
 Fixed the issue with email notifications overlapping with the rocket launch screen
 Corrected the Polish translation
 Status bar now updates correctly
 Fixed the issue with positive traits displaying in red
 Fixed the issue with the loan time displaying incorrectly in the Finance>Loans card
 And more!

Keep giving us awesome ideas and suggestions on Steam and Discord. Thank you all for helping us make this update happen. If you like the changes, please consider dropping us a review on Steam—we’d love to hear what you think!

Stay on course and aim for the stars!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/e05ea248f3da60bd8b835d31e1d6be5c094d7b75.jpg

Dear CEOs,Steam Trading Cards are now available in Space Company Simulator! You can get them by playing the game and trading with other users on the Community Market. Collect the full set to craft a one-of-a-kind badge that you can display on your Steam profile. Each badge will earn you random drops of emoticons and backgrounds.

You can now step up your Steam profile with:
 Regular badge (5 levels)
 Foil badge (1 level)
 7 profile backgrounds
 10 emoticons
Have a great time playing and earning your badge!

How to collect Steam Trading CardsPlay Space Company Simulator to get cards. Up to half the card set is dropped through game play. You can get the rest of the set by trading with other players on the Community Market.

How to craft a badgeOnce you’ve collected a full set of cards you can craft them into a game badge. Badges can be crafted by accessing the Badges tab on your Steam profile. There are 5 levels of a regular badge to craft and one foil badge.

During badge crafting you'll receive random rewards, such as emoticons and backgrounds.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/9656b4a136a82eddd39621df2449aecbfa6936af.jpg

Dear Space CEOs!We know it’s been a while, but a fresh Space Company Simulator update is here with improvements and changes that will make your space missions go more smoothly.

The update contains an optimization upgrade, brand new contracts, and plenty of fixes. Check out the detailed changelog below!

📢 Features: Added 7 new contracts
 Added summaries of a contract’s objectives in a single sentence
 Added a new round of optimizations, which should significantly increase frame rates
⚙ Changes: Added more emails
 Added the possibility to turn the Day/Night Mode off in the Settings, which can prevent some bugs related to it from appearing
 Improved notification UX (user experience)
 Improved University UX
 Added quality of life improvements to GUI (game’s user interface)
 Changed profits and penalties for completing contracts
 Modified employee random leveling system (now based on the selected difficulty level)
 Changed the University’s learning time from days to turns
 Improved employee skills descriptions
 Removed the possibility to launch the departments menu from Mission Control window
 Removed the possibility to launch the Conference Center menu with hotkey
 Improved the University translations
 Removed the button which restarted the game after losing the game
 The effects of locked astronaut and manager traits are no longer visible
🔧 Fixes: Improved the positioning of building markups so that they no longer block the view of other buildings
 The second engine can now be placed in a rocket correctly
 A notification now correctly appears in the Building mode when there’s a new building available to be built
 Improved the Scholarships Perk description
 Improved the font size—it now works well with bigger numbers
 Fixed an issue with email content not fitting the window
 Fixed an issue with text missing in contracts and emails
 Fixed various localization issues
 Fixed the bug with inability to add more astronauts to manned missions if one of them quit
 Fixed the bug whereby the same astronaut could be sent on two manned missions at the same time
 Fixed the issue with windows not closing
 Fixed the camera view for Medium and Heavy rockets
 Improved the achievement descriptions and their calculation method
 Scrolling emails no longer scrolls the atlas of planets
 Fixed worker morale (max 100)
 Fixed the save window—it is now impossible to save the game without a name
 Workers can no longer be sent to train the skill they already maxed out
 It is now impossible to continue the game after going bankrupt
 Removed the button for planning flights in missions not involving flights
 Fixed the icon with the number of mails—a large quantity of emails is now displayed correctly
 It is no longer possible to move the University progress bar by hand
 Fixed an issue whereby new contracts were set for 0 turns
 Corrected the email informing about the contract’s completion failure
 The ‘Start Chain’ caption no longer disappears
 Fixed issues related to loading a save during gameplay from the in-game menu (as opposed to loading it from the main menu)
 Fixed an issue whereby too many windows appeared in the Assembly
 Corrected several trait tooltips
 Fixed issues with contract visibility
 Added missing text to placeholders
 Fixed an issue with blocked contracts
 Added ‘Speed’ and ‘Altitude’ translations
 Corrected various translation issues
 Fixed an issue with the Mailbox window
 Optimized Planet Atlas
 Fixed Planet Atlas bugs related to the constant emerging of new orbits
 Fixed Planet Atlas culling issue which could crash the game
 Fixed additional black screen issues
 Fixed an issue whereby skipping a significant amount of turns would crash the game
 Fixed University tabs issues
 Fixed an issue which prevented employees from being sent to advanced University courses
 Fixed an issue with the displaying the Management Courses for astronauts in the University window
 Fixed an issue with the blocked ‘Foreign Start’ contract after loading the save file (the contract no longer appears as ‘in progress’)
 Improved the responsiveness of the astronaut assigning button
 Fixed an issue whereby the value of gained points on the top of the window as well as the component names in the component creation would disappear when the ‘construct a building’ option was clicked twice
 Positive employee traits are no longer displayed in red
 Fixed an issue whereby it was possible to exploit the number of investors
 Fixed an issue with incorrect calculation of unlocked and locked lobbyists
 Fixed an issue with an incorrect calculation of the amount of components that are ready to be constructed
 Fixed an issue whereby the cost and turn counter of components that are required to be built would reset after constructing the maximum amount of components
 Added a tooltip notifying that it is impossible to construct a component
 Added various other minor fixes
Thank you all for helping us make this update happen! Keep giving us awesome ideas and suggestions on Steam and Discord.

Please consider dropping us a review on Steam if you’re satisfied with the update. Let other CEOs learn about the game!

Cheers!

notes.content:

Dear Space CEOs!The new Space Company Simulator update has been released on Steam. It introduces a brand new Sandbox Assembly, Historical Events, and multiple fixes! You can find more information about the new features and a detailed changelog below.

Sandbox Assembly{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/8e98f96ad8aa585cd1c681f63ffaa13005e1db11.jpg

Running your own space company is not an easy job. Taking care of finances and planning can consume plenty of time. Have you ever wondered what it would be like to have unlimited resources and just focus on assembling rockets?

With the new Sandbox Assembly, you can experiment with various rocket setups. Choose any of the available blueprints and buy any components you want. When price is no longer an issue, you can get components of the highest rarity without consulting your financial advisors. With unlimited resources, you can launch an unlimited number of rockets!

You can enter this mode from the main menu (“Sandbox Assembly”). You will be directed straight to the assembly.

Historical Events{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/71c1302b29f5dd49d6a43ac538710ccc0daaae31.jpg

Space exploration events are among the most important in humankind’s history. We want to appreciate and celebrate them, so we added the Historical Events feature which introduces crucial milestones of space exploration. Special tooltips are now displayed after hovering over the star icon on the top navigation panel. The events do not affect the gameplay but serve as great reminders that you and your company can accomplish great things too.

 Added possibility to create a research chain - select and automate an order of research that will be performed one after another

Thank you for your help in making this update happen! Please continue sharing your fantastic ideas and suggestions with us. We look forward to hearing from you on Steam and Discord.

Also, if you’re satisfied with the changes, please consider dropping us a review on Steam. They help other space explorers learn more about the game and give us a chance to hear from the players who know SCS best.

notes.title: Build your own rocket!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/bea10fa6f8fd08a9db4d26ed60512ca7112385ce.jpg

Space Company Simulator will put you in charge of assembling new rockets. You will choose from a variety of components, including:

 Fuel tanks
 Engines
 Utility modules
 Grid fins
 Rocket struts
 Utility modules
 And more

You start by selecting the rocket blueprint. In the example above, the Small Rocket “Wolf-3” has been chosen - a small, uncomplicated rocket, capable of carrying a limited cargo into the air. Its construction takes 13 turns by default.

By investing in the Component Market, a large selection of components becomes available for purchase. To enhance the rocket above, two components were purchased:

 Small Prototype Engine “Contender” MK-01 - a prototype low thrust engine that can be used with lightweight payloads only. Due to its nature, it is unlikely to be suitable for prolonged use.
 Prototype Fuel Tank “Donkey” FT-1 - a prototype liquid fuel tank, allowing for simple rocket tests and lifting a light object into the air. It can have a problem with ensuring the required amount of fuel to get out of the atmosphere. 
 Prototype Cargo Bay CRB-01 - a prototype version of the cargo hold, designed for use in small rockets. Its level of sophistication and performance leaves a lot of room for improvement, but it will be just right for testing.
 Small Strut LDB-01 - a lightweight version of the strut used to reinforce the rocket’s supporting structure. Its low bending strength is compensated for by its use in truss systems, and its weight allows it to be used effectively on small objects and rockets.
 Small Grid Fins LS-1 - thanks to the Grid Fins, this rocket is controllable during the landing sequence. This substandard version is not very advanced, but it is enough to bring our rockets back to the ground. In most cases.
 HGA I - the HGA antenna generates an extremely strong signal that allows better communication with the base.
 IVA Suit - a basic suit used inside spacecraft. Not suitable for spacewalks.

After assembling its components, each rocket can be tested to determine the probability of a successful launch. Lastly, the rocket is assigned to a mission and awaits its start.

With that knowledge, you’re ready to build your first rocket and launch it into space!

notes.title: Loans
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/b892d48729e137e93fec1f1409c8164d2544e419.png

If you read our previous article about finances and how to manage them, then you’re on the right track to becoming a prospective CEO. However, sometimes you might slip up and find yourself in desperate need of some additional cash. Or your business plan might require investing a significant amount of money at the beginning for long-term benefits. In such cases, a loan may come in handy.

To apply for a loan, your company must first meet some essential requirements, such as:
 Having a certain minimum value and an average income
 Not exceeding a certain maximum value of remaining debts
 Having a certain lifespan
Loans have two payment types: singular and repetitive. The former requires you to pay the whole amount at once, while the latter is split into regular smaller chunks.

So, do you think you’re ready for the October 24 Early Access release? Make sure to check out previous articles about the game’s mechanics:
 Schedule conferences
 Failing to plan is planning to fail
 Keep your finances in order
 Your motto defines you
Follow the game to stay up-to-date with more news like this!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: Failing to plan is planning to fail
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/8ce12ad636f5513f5fdb74e57858719ad131302a.jpg

In Space Company Simulator, the gameplay is based on turns. A single turn represents seven days of the company’s lifetime and there are four turns during each month. Each move can take you a long way, so you have to be sure it’s the direction you want to go!

Most of the in-game actions that influence the progress of your company take a certain amount of turns, including:

 Building a rocket
 Fulfilling a contract
 Taking out loans
 Testing components
 Researching new technologies


It’s your task to carefully plan your actions. Some of them, such as researching technologies, can only be performed one at a time. Make sure to arrange the work with care to reach the best outcome and let your company prosper.

As in chess, if you don’t have a few moves planned at a time, you might find yourself with no way out. Prepare to have your strategic skills challenged!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: Keep your finances in order
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/873c0eaec4a4fbb291e3d3a4ccee16ee7ad6df0c.png

Recently, we explained the importance of managing your company’s prestige. But that’s not the only factor you’ll have to keep in mind. After all, no company can function without a budget.

Here are some of the things you should take into consideration when distributing your funds and monitoring your account balance:

 Department budgets & their perks
 Benefits from the work of department managers
 Conference bonuses or penalties for not fulfilling their pledges
 Paying off loans
 University costs for staff
 Return of investment from unused funds
 And more!

Prepare to analyze huge amounts of data and think long-term. You will need to be aware of everything and be ready to alter your strategy to fit the ever-changing situation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: Your motto defines you
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/24f071f5c5e34352b40aaa03cc37458f06295d5c.png

When you start a new game in Space Company Simulator, you are asked to pick a motto. Be sure to give this special consideration since it will define the early strategy of your company, as each motto comes with unique starting bonuses. Craft the strategy with first and second priority departments in mind and excel in the early stages of the space race.

SCIENCE CULTURE

notes.title: Raise the Prestige
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34306602/f99b62bace00de8357f848cebc5c42cee91f40d1.png

As the CEO of a space company, it’s up to you to maintain the company’s public image. The popularity of the company is represented by its Prestige value.

The prestige is influenced by several factors:

 Work of department managers
 Funding for the PR department
 Conference bonuses
 Worker morale
 Growth from department perks
 Finished contracts or penalties for not completing contracts
 And more

After reaching a certain amount of Prestige, the company receives access to new lobbyists, who allow you to receive increased funds from investors. Manage your reputation well and your company will prosper!

Add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: How to manage Finances
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34306602/f30b5de0c02ee8616053b3331a802e925061db98.png

You already know the importance of the PR & HR, Science, and Production facilities. They are all key components of a successful space company, but they also require funds to be built. Now that's where the Finance departments come into play!

 Administration - the department responsible for overseeing the company's budget
 Space Programs - departments responsible for various space missions:
       • Rocket Program
       • Satellite Program
       • Tourism Program
       • Moon Program
       • Space Station Program
       • Mars Program
       • Neo (deep space) Program

As the CEO of the company, you will decide which space programs to invest in first.

We won the moon race; now it's time for us to live and work on Mars, first on its moons and then on its surface.
~Buzz Aldrin

Add the game to your wishlist and get ready to manage your own space company:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: A word about the Production buildings
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34306602/4c9bddc67feea6c50cbcb5e6ca3f502ea7f61cce.jpg

In previous entries, we outlined the benefits of the PR & HR facilities, followed by the Science buildings. Today, you will learn more about the Production branch, which is essential to achieving the company's ultimate goal: launching space missions.

 Assembly - construct components and whole spaceships and send them into space.
 Airstrip, Launch Pads, Extended Launcher - launch and land space vehicles of different sizes.
 Test Center - test the reliability of components and vehicles.

Manage the company well and soon you'll experience the unforgettable thrill of launching your first rocket into space.

I think we're going to the moon because it's in the nature of the human being to face challenges. It's by the nature of his deep inner soul... we're required to do these things just as salmon swim upstream.
~Neil Armstrong

Follow the game on Steam and stay up to date with the latest news:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: The power of Science
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34306602/48d3486e662b90dd4ad81b0c94ce0a7ad543167d.jpg

We’ve already introduced you to the  PR and Human Resources facilities. Now it's time to take a closer look at the Science complex and how it can influence the growth of your company.

 Research & Development - research technologies to create new spaceship elements and increase their reliability.
 University - build a University to help your employees to learn and increase their knowledge.
 Mission Control - check the progress of space missions and observe the position of spaceships in the solar system.


Equipped with his five senses, man explores the universe around him and calls the adventure Science.
~Edwin Powell Hubble

Follow the game to stay up to date with the latest news:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/

notes.title: Invest in PR & Human Resources
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34306602/ea3282c47f5efa051b849cc7b69a956bdc89f8b9.jpg

The key components of a dynamically prospering space agency are its facilities. Without a proper headquarters, your company management possibilities would be highly limited.

Although their role might sometimes be neglected, your space company needs PR and HR departments, which handle external and internal public relations. 

Find out how your corporation can benefit from their services:

 Conference Center - a representative place to hold press conferences
 PR - a department dedicated to managing relations with investors
 Astronaut Complex - a place where your pilots will gain the much-needed experience
 Human Resources - a bureau responsible for hiring qualified employees

In the next entries, we’ll introduce Science, Production, and Finance facilities.

Add the game to your wishlist and follow it to stay up to date:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923970/Space_Company_Simulator/
